post.description: Find PDB entries for a protein, gene product, organism, ligand or method; join from UniProt with `uniprot_accession` or from a drug with `ligand`. Then call `structure` for chains, ligands, citation and download links.

experimental_method.description:
Combined experimental method label.

Provider reference: allowed values ["X-ray", "EM", "NMR", "Neutron", "Multiple methods", "Integrative", "Other"].

ligand.description: Structures containing this Chemical Component Dictionary id as a non-polymer ligand, e.g. `STI` (imatinib), `HEM`, `ATP`. Look ids up with the `ligand` function. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,5}$.

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 10.

max_resolution.description:
Best resolution cutoff in ångströms (≤). Entries without a resolution (most NMR) are excluded when set.

Provider reference: maximum 100.

offset.description:
Number of hits to skip; pass the previous page's `next_offset`.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 1000000; default 0.

organism.description: Source organism scientific name, matched case-insensitively against the NCBI taxonomy lineage of every polymer entity, so `Escherichia coli` includes its strains and `Mammalia` includes every mammal.

query.description: Full-text search over titles, descriptions, keywords, organisms, ligand names, citations and annotations, e.g. `imatinib`, `spike glycoprotein`, `CRISPR Cas9`.

released_after.description: Initial release on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

released_before.description: Initial release on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sort.description:
`relevance` (search score), `newest` (initial release date, newest first) or `resolution` (best first, entries without a resolution last).

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "newest", "resolution"]; default "relevance".

uniprot_accession.description: Structures with a polymer entity mapped to this UniProtKB accession (SIFTS/RCSB reference sequence mapping), e.g. `P69905` for human hemoglobin alpha. Pattern: ^([OPQopq][0-9][A-Za-z0-9]{3}[0-9]|[A-NR-Za-nr-z][0-9]([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{2}[0-9]){1,2})$.

200.description:
Search the PDB archive of experimental structures through the RCSB Search API, then summarize each hit through the Data API: PDB ID, title, experimental method, resolution, release date, source organisms, UniProt accessions and search score. Combine full text with filters for organism (NCBI taxonomy lineage), experimental method, maximum resolution, release-date range, UniProt accession and bound ligand; filters are ANDed and at least one criterion is required. Offset-paginated through `next_offset`. Computed structure models (AlphaFold/ModelArchive) are excluded. An empty page is a valid result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.
